articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor dumped AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on public GitHub because apparently irony is dead. The cybersecurity agency's own contractor just handed hackers the crown jewels on a silver platter.

articles.title: The Hackers Behind Shai-Hulud: Lucky or Skilled?
articles.summary: 'Megalodon' malware devoured 5,500+ GitHub repos in just six hours, stealing dev credentials and secrets. The supply chain attack we've all been dreading finally grew teeth.

articles.title: Trend Micro users beware - dangerous Apex One zero-day exploited in the wild
